newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks hold gains to close at new highs.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks hold gains to close at new highs.

text.p: Madrid stock indices held onto earlier gains to close at new highs on Wednesday after what traders saw as a day of consolidation.
In the short-term, traders said they could not rule out the possibility of a technical correction bearing in mind the weakness of other stock markets.
The general index climbed 0.54 points, 0.14 percent, to close at 391.35. The Ibex-35 index of leading shares closed up 6.06 points, 0.13 percent, at 4,512.91.
"The market is relatively stable at these levels and although stocks appear to be well supported, a technical correction cannot be ruled out if other stock markets continue to fall," said one trader.
Trading focussed largely on Telefonica, Repsol and Endesa which accounted for 40 percent of turnover. Total turnover was lower than that seen on Tuesday at 48 billion pesetas.
Telefonica ended five pesetas down at 2,780, while Repsol rose 40 pesetas to 4,390. Endesa gained 30 pesetas to 8,020.
Traders said U.S. balance of payments data put some pressure on stocks earlier in the afternoon but failed to permanently dampen the positive spirit in the market.
